info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Location Data Management-spec
info.description: The Market Data Location Management API enables businesses to effectively manage market data location settings. This API allows for the addition of new market data locations, ensuring accurate and timely access to essential financial data. Typical consumers include financial institutions and data analysts seeking to optimize their market data strategies. By utilizing this API, users can streamline the configuration and management of market data feeds to enhance their decision-making processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new location data within the market data management system. Ensure to provide all necessary details in the request body for successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to manage location data in the market data system. It allows for the addition, updating, or deletion of location-related information and must be formatted as JSON.

201.description: Resource created successfully, indicating that the location data has been added.
